notes.title: STAND: Plagues of Oblivion is now LIVE !
notes.notes:
Hi survivors !

The V.1.1 introduce a huge expansion : [b]Plagues of Oblivion[/b], but also alot of improvements and new contents.

Let's start with the base game :

- First of all, the [b]Swap System[/b] has been fixed, finally ! Thank you for your patience.

- New Icons (Items, Weapons, Skills, Enemies avatar)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45274939/26e3f26ce3e3c4c79130dcd77590f66f7d0b992b.png[/img]

- New ranks visual & Increased xp to rank up (100 -> 200)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45274939/623ef2b5e5af361ab0a08f8d01bdb3cc07cb02a8.png[/img]

- Now you can earn trader reroll by opening resource chests

- Interface enhanced with blood mask according to % Health
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45274939/5cf9f93bec3f5472c61f67af69fb0f7c7f7ae9c2.png[/img]

- Brightness option
- Overall brightness improvement
- Intensified icon rarity colors
- New chapter names & story description
- Improved item names and descriptions
- Increasing difficulty (Hard & Nightmare mode)
- Difficulty balance (Easy mode)
- Fixed melee weapon collision
- Global UI improvement and visual changes
- Display of character sprites in the menu fixed
- New logo and Steam capsules

The [u]Road map[/u] has also been uptaded :
- Melee combat improvement
- New menu background
- New weapons, items & spells
- New game announcement

And NOW, here's the new free expansion : [b]Plagues of Oblivion[/b]

Get ready to crush waves of monsters straight outta Oblivion! Load up your heroes with epic gear and spells to wreck 
spiders and dragons in three all-new chapters. Try out new combos and last as long as you can !

[b]3 New chapters[/b] !
- The awakening
- Silent waters
- Gate of Oblivion

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45274939/e7b59f75716c84f03688d111f1c7975f682d55ad.png[/img]

[b]14 New enemies[/b] !
- Slime
- Spider 
- Rat
- Wolf
- Goblin
- Dragon
- .......

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45274939/5dfd2e4b7f33d95c76bb50b74135f52a93b19ae5.png[/img]

[b]60+ New weapons, spells and items[/b] !
- Bow
- Catapult
- Fireball
- .......

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45274939/37f933525c44252bf3e835bc0821edf2fbe457e5.png[/img]

- New quest, stats, leaderboard & more


[i]There is no new Steam Achievement for now, as I know this can be annoying for those who have 100%. But if I have some requests, I can add new ones.[/i]


Last & [b]important[/b] thing :

This extension was supposed to be paid for, but then I changed my mind and wanted everyone to be able to play Plagues of Oblivion.
If you like and want to support the game, you can [u]leave a review[/u], on Steam. This is such a huge source of motivation and help the game get noticed.
And, if you want to support even more, there is a new supporter pack for 0.99$ with 71 new cosmetics to dress like a real viking !

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3701020/?snr=1_5_9__205]STAND: Plagues of Oblivion supporter pack[/url]

Thank you for playing STAND and have fun with the Plagues of Oblivion !

[b]Survive, Team-up, And Never Die ![/b]

notes.title: STAND - Future Uptade !
notes.notes:
Hi survivors !

I wanted to inform you about what's coming soon to STAND.

First of all, the release of the expansion: [i]Plagues of Oblivion[/i]. Three new chapters, new enemies, weapons, clothing, and much more ! The release will be in [b]May[/b], and the price of this DLC will be either $0.99 or $1.99 at most, I'm not sure yet.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45274939/4bbe36ecb5b004e130500d7c426752a7d295c996.jpg[/img]

But that's not all: the base game will also receive improvements such as a brightness option, increased difficulty in Hard and Nightmare modes, bug fixes, visual enhancements and more.

Thank you for playing STAND and see you soon for new challenges !

Survive, Team-up, And Never Die !

notes.title: V.1.0 Release and Best Survivors !
notes.notes:
[u]Hi Survivors ![/u]

The release of the [b]V.1.0[/b] is coming soon, with the new and final chapter : [u]City[/u], and more.

Thank you for the support during early access, it was a pleasure to work on this game.
[u]BUT[/u], this is not the end, an extension is planned and has already started to be developed :
"[b]Plagues of Oblivion[/b]", which will be released in 2025.

For the transition to 1.0, you'll keep all your progress and statistics. 
Only the leaderboards will be reset to make it fair between the two versions.

notes.title: STAND: Early Access Release Date !
notes.notes:
Hey

The early access of [b]STAND[/b], will be released on Steam [b]November 20[/b].
The price is set to the minimum : 0.99$, and you'll have a 10% reduction for the first two weeks.

Futur contents is already in development and will be ready soon, if you want to see the progress, you can join the [b]Discord[/b] : https://discord.gg/5CbsPu9CGH

notes.title: Closed Beta access !
notes.notes:
Hey survivors,

A pre test has been done with some of my guy and now it's ready for all !
To get access to the closed beta, simply join the [url=https://discord.gg/5CbsPu9CGH]Discord[/url] and say something like : "give me access to the closed beta please" or whatever.

Your feeback is very important, you can leave any comments you want to improve the game, ideas, bugs, features and more.

The early access will be ready for end november / early december.

Survivre, Teamp-up And Never Die !
